Name: AutoFenceGate
Author: LucasBennett617
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Automatically opens and closes fence gates when you get near them. Walk up to a gate and it opens, walk away and it closes

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI from https://smapi.io/
2. Download and extract this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
3. Launch the game through SMAPI
4. (Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu for easy configuration

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- Gates automatically open when you approach (default: 2.5 tiles)
- Gates automatically close when you walk away
- Works in multiplayer for all players
- Fully configurable through Generic Mod Config Menu
- Press F5 in-game to reload settings
- Optimized performance with cooldown system
- No conflicts with vanilla mechanics

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- SMAPI 4.5 or higher
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for in-game configuration)

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Thanks to the SMAPI development team for making Stardew Valley modding accessible, and to the modding community for inspiration and support.
